KBH10B & KBH20B PcBN mini tip inserts are the prime solution for machining hardened steels. Improve edge prep and get optimal surface finish with their unique wiper design. Both grades are available in single and double-sided geometries. Watch these innovative tools in action in this short video.


***This video was previously featured on Kennametal's***[YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Dgh2ilp0n_w) ***.***
